elements.text:
You are looking through your social media app and see a number of your friends have posted to their stories. As you look through their photos, you realize that a few of your close friends were all hanging out without you. 

Here are some thoughts that might pop into mind:

texts: Others might wonder if I was excluded intentionally, but I doubt that will actually happen.
I think about all the wonderful photos I took with my friends.
I think they meant to leave me out of the gathering.
My friends must not actually like me. But, I know that's not the case; we have a lot of fun together.
